scope: Customer complaint about an owned delivered order, through existing authenticated support and exception inbox
support: One complaint case per order; actual existing support session and private image/receipt protocol, no customer-to-driver or merchant messaging
policy: Existing OPERATIONAL_SETTINGS#ORDER_EXCEPTION_CASES: normal claim window, safety late reporting and frozen response/escalation/appeal durations
decisions: Owner review, evidence, reason disclosed to customer, separate internal reason, documented responsibility requiring independent sources; no automatic driver performance or financial writes
compensation: Existing personal goods benefit grant, exact approved amount, proof of actual grant linkage before closure. Never described as cash returned. Cash disputes use existing customer cash review. No delivery guarantee reopening or settled-money rewrite
appeal: One per current decision; time starts at customer acknowledgement. Preserves decisions and reopens the same queue record; no automatic reversal of a previously recorded grant
photos: Existing support upload -> server-confirmed image message -> immutable attachment/checksum reference in complaint. Access remains protected and expired images are reported unavailable; no invented permanent image retention period
deletion: New complaint records conservatively block cleanup pending case/retention review; X02 policy for closed safety/quality evidence remains outstanding, no new automatic purge/TTL

tests.sourceAnalysis: No errors or warnings in new customer files; informational style lints remain

publicationBlockedBy: Automatic approval review rejected persistent IAM role changes and the five-Lambda deployment as outside the general C05 approval; no deployment was attempted afterward.
publicationApprovalScope: Five staging Lambdas, limited nonfinancial support/proof IAM grants, central frontend deployment; no production changes
